review:
An early, old-school Nolimit game on 5x3, with two features triggered by Hot Zones on reels 2 and 4. Matching symbols in both zones can trigger expanding wilds that cover whole reels.

The other feature is Spin 'til You Win: respins that keep going until a win lands, each failed spin boosting the next. Medium volatility, a 2,000x cap and 96.74% RTP. Gentle – nothing like what Nolimit's known for today.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
